mutations.name: a-busy-session-runs-anyway
mutations._mechanism: The refusal printed and then fell through: the second session measures a tree another run is rewriting, which is the 6-and-3-failures-in-different-sets case this lock exists to stop.

mutations.name: the-session-never-asks-for-the-lock
mutations._mechanism: The feature removed wholesale: every session treats itself as an enclosing run's child, so nothing is ever refused and an unparseable lock is silently ignored.

mutations.name: the-holder-token-is-never-exported
mutations._mechanism: Without the token the harness's own inner pytest finds the tree held by its parent and refuses, so every real spec run reads BASELINE_NOT_GREEN.

mutations.name: any-token-naming-the-lock-exempts
mutations._mechanism: The env is inherited blindly; a token left by a holder that died, or whose lock another run has since taken, would let a stranger measure a held tree.

mutations.name: audit-gate-scores-a-busy-run
mutations._mechanism: A refused session falls through to summary parsing and is scored on whatever pytest printed; BUSY must read as cannot-judge with its own reason.

mutations.name: wire-registry-scores-a-busy-run-as-broken
mutations._mechanism: A refused session has an empty outcome table, and run_pins reads every absent pin as BROKEN: a held tree becomes a FAIL naming every wire as a regression.

mutations.name: the-plugin-never-registers
mutations._mechanism: Review M1's shape: the lock code exists but no session runs it, so `pytest handoff/tests` measures a held tree in silence.

mutations.name: the-install-path-registers-nothing
mutations._mechanism: `pytest ~/.claude/skills/h-mad/tests/` has no root conftest above it; without the h-mad conftest's own registration an installed skill's suite never takes the lock.

mutations.name: a-dead-holders-token-still-exempts
mutations._mechanism: Review S1: a SIGKILLed harness's orphaned inner pytest carries a token whose pid IS the lock's holder; without the liveness half it runs exempt while a third run stale-takes the lock, and two measured runs overlap.

mutations.name: an-unwritable-lock-is-an-internal-error
mutations._mechanism: Review S2: a read-only checkout, or `.h-mad` existing as a file, turns every session in the tree into an INTERNALERROR with no remedy line.
mutations.find:
except OSError as exc:
            # A read-only checkout
mutations.replace:
except ZeroDivisionError as exc:
            # A read-only checkout

mutations.name: sigterm-leaves-the-lock
mutations._mechanism: Review S3: SIGTERM is how a backgrounded suite is stopped; without the handler its lock outlives it and only a stale-take, trusting the pid alone, recovers it.

mutations.name: a-recycled-pid-holds-the-tree
mutations._mechanism: Review S3: a lock left by a killed run names a pid the OS has since given to an unrelated process; trusting the pid alone makes every run in the tree read BUSY until that stranger exits.
mutations.find: return not (isinstance(started, (int, float)) and began is not None and began > started + 2)

mutations.name: an-empty-lock-invites-deleting-a-live-one
mutations._mechanism: Review N2: between O_EXCL create and payload write a live lock reads empty; telling the reader to delete it without retrying first can break a real holder.
mutations.find: "holder caught mid-write: retry in a second before anything else, and "

mutations.name: the-busy-holder-is-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Review N4: `run_suite` returns the holder and the printed line dropped it, so the operator could not see who held the tree.

mutations.name: the-shared-configure-drops-the-lock
mutations._mechanism: R2-M1's shape, one direction: the single pytest_configure keeps the stem-dir job and loses the tree-lock registration, so an install-path run measures a held tree.

mutations.name: the-shared-configure-drops-the-stem-dir
mutations._mechanism: R2-M1 as it happened: a second pytest_configure rebound the name and the stem-dir export vanished without a merge conflict, sending ~900 stems back to the shared /tmp.

mutations.name: an-ignored-sigterm-is-overridden
mutations._mechanism: R2-N2: a session started under `trap '' TERM` gets a handler that re-kills with SIG_DFL, so the caller's explicit ignore stops meaning anything.
